# dsh-kernel-minimax
DSH runs on one simple idea: **everything is a plugin**. Models, tools, subagents — plug them togeth
er however you like.
So we did exactly that: we turned MiniMax's **Mini-Agent into a DSH plugin**. The mini-agent tool su
rface you already know — `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `bash`, `bash_output`, `bash_kill`,
`get_skill`, `list_skills`, `record_note`, `recall_notes` — is now a set of native DSH tools. Same
names, same schemas, same behavior.
The payoff is simple: use Mini-Agent's tools natively inside DSH — **no different** from opening Min
i-Agent itself. Every model stays in the environment it knows best — main agent or subagent, it feel
ry model stays in the environment it knows best — main agent or subagent, it feels like coming home.
Distilled from MiniMax-AI/Mini-Agent `d76a4f6` (2026-02-14). No new model-facing tools since then.

## System prompt

`lib/system-prompt.js` carries the upstream **Mini-Agent** `system_prompt.md`
(skill metadata adapte

d to DSH); `apply()` registers it as the agent's sole
system-prompt section (`complete: true` + `sup
pressRuntimeContext()`).

Mini-Agent has no subagent tool upstream, so this package ships no L2 subagent
recipes.
## Install
1. Install the plugin into your profile with the official plugin command:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
GitHub also works (`dsh plugin --profile web add github:oppnc/dsh-kernel-minimax`) because `lib/` sh
ips in the repository.
This package is a plain plugin (no `dsh.bundle` declaration), so `dsh plugin` installs it as an inac
tive dependency — that is expected: the preset row below references it by name.
2. The `minimax-kernel` agent preset ships in `dsh-kernel-mesh`'s `presets/` directory. Copy it into
the official user-preset root (or, if you run without the mesh, get the preset directory from the m
ial user-preset root (or, if you run without the mesh, get the preset directory from the mesh repo):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The preset already includes the `minimax-surface` row; if you author your own preset, add it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Usage
Pick the `minimax-kernel` preset and the `minimax-kernel / MiniMax-M2.5` model route. Your main agen
t runs on the Mini-Agent tool surface.
